text: {"status":"unresolved","evidence_ids":["ev-5ba7f0eadd904a0add85056c","ev-54ffb0964eab50c0a8461805","ev-9c17747679a6fc7e543fa258"],"request_dft":true,"proposed_test_ids":["scope_gap"],"rationale":"The claim is that the available calculations establish a physically reliable relaxed-configuration ranking among four sampled configurations. The evidence does not support that. Only two statics exist (ideal MATS-0080 at -7.828097 eV/atom, random1 MATS-0081 at -7.827905 eV/atom). The ideal-minus-random1 difference is -0.192 meV/atom, which is only a finite-mesh static ordering, as ev-5ba7f0eadd904a0add85056c itself says ('not a qualified relaxed-configuration ranking'). Both preceding relaxations are not_converged (ev-47538e8e8ffb560efba09b7b, ev-a6ae516463066bcf748458cd) because ionic-step SCF cycles hit NELM, so the geometries are not qualified relaxed structures. Random2 (ev-b5f9de910d86bf461b725bcf) was terminated by walltime and random3 (ev-bea28ffbd28caf685397e4a9) failed with an MPI error; neither has a static result, and not_converged or failed_to_compute records count neither for nor against.
